author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play the free Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties demo now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/yakuza-kiwami-3-and-dark-ties-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Legends collide in Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties! In Yakuza Kiwami 3, continue the story of Kazuma Kiryu in an action-filled remake of Yakuza 3, featuring reimagined combat, enhanced graphics, additional scenes, and more. In Dark Ties, experience the brand-new tale of Yoshitaka Mine as he steps willingly into the dark world of the yakuza after losing everything. 

Try both action-packed stories in this two-in-one experience before the full game launches Feb 12, 2026!
